study: Monthly book. Five price-only rules, fixed now, each pick 20 liquid US stocks at a month-end and hold them to the next month-end. Does any beat SPY by more than its market risk, out of sample, after costs?
registered_at: 2026-10-19, before any monthly return in this study was computed.
origin: Operator 2026-10-19: move from day trading to holding names for a month; find the names that will make the best monthly profit.
prior_evidence: Stated before the run. LONGER_HOLDS_2026-09-27: monthly 12-1 momentum on ~900 liquid names beat SPY on CAGR but not on alpha (OOS +3.3%/yr, t 0.3, beta 1.4). MOMENTUM_FAIR_2026-10-02: top 5 of 100 by 12-1, +168 bp/month t 1.36, made by three mania months; without them +55 bp t 0.5; beta 1.8. Plain 12-1 momentum is therefore NOT a rule here. The five rules below are different signals; R1 is momentum divided by its own volatility, which the earlier tests did not run.
data: ai_reports/gapdown/daily.pkl on the mini (tools/studies/gapdown_short.py --daily): adjusted daily SIP (open, close) 2016-01-04..2026-10-15 for every US common stock that was ever liquid (ACTIVE and INACTIVE assets, so delisted names are in), SPY, and each name's liquid dates (raw close >= $10 and 20-day mean dollar volume >= $20M, from the prior session). No volume, high or low is stored, so the rules are close-only.
rebalance: The last session of each month (from SPY's calendar) is a rebalance day t. Every input is computed from adjusted closes up to the session BEFORE t; the book is bought at t's close and held to the next rebalance day's close. A name is eligible on t if t is one of its liquid dates and it has at least 253 adjusted closes up to the session before t.

rules.R1_smooth_momentum: 12-1 return (close 21 sessions back / close 252 sessions back - 1) divided by the standard deviation of daily log returns over the last 252 sessions. Top 20.
rules.R2_near_52w_high: Last close / highest close of the last 252 sessions. Top 20 (closest to the 52-week high).
rules.R3_low_volatility: Lowest standard deviation of daily log returns over the last 60 sessions. 20 names.
rules.R4_trend_low_vol: Last close above its 200-session mean close, then the lowest 60-session volatility among those. 20 names.
rules.R5_one_month_reversal: Lowest 21-session return (close / close 21 sessions back - 1). 20 names.

returns: Equal weight, 20 names. A name's return is its close on the next rebalance day / close on t - 1. A name with no close on the next rebalance day (delisted, halted) uses its last close before that day; the count is printed. This ignores any delisting loss after the last print and so flatters the book slightly.
cost: 10 bp per unit of weight traded, per side, at each rebalance (the measured round trip on $10+ names is about 3 bp; 10 bp is a deliberate cushion). The first month pays a full buy.
benchmarks: SPY over the same month (total return from adjusted closes). Also printed: the equal-weight average of every eligible name (the universe), so a rule that only earns the small-stock or equal-weight effect is visible.
halves: Months are dated by the rebalance day that starts them. Warm-up: the first rebalance with 253 prior sessions is 2016-12-30. Half A: holding months starting 2016-12-30 through 2021-11-30 (60). Half B: starting 2021-12-31 through 2026-08-31 (57; the month starting 2026-09-30 ends 2026-10-30, after the data). Nothing is fit; the rules have no parameters chosen from data.
call: Per rule, monthly net book return regressed on SPY's (OLS, intercept = alpha per month). PASS: alpha > 0 in both halves; pooled alpha t >= 2.33 (one-sided 1% for five rules, Bonferroni); net minus SPY > 0 in both halves; and the pooled alpha stays > 0 without the 3 best months (the mania check from MOMENTUM_FAIR). PROMISING: alpha > 0 in both halves, pooled t >= 1.5, still > 0 without the 3 best months. FAIL otherwise. A PASS earns the final holdout and a paper book, never money directly.
power: About 117 months, 57-60 a half. The minimum detectable alpha at t 2 is printed per rule (2 x residual SD / sqrt(months)); expect roughly 1% a month. A FAIL does not rule out a smaller edge.
final_holdout: Only for a PASS or PROMISING rule, unchanged, on the 2000-2015 data (data/yahoo_pre2016), under its own short prereg written after this result and before that run. It is not touched here.
what_is_printed: Per rule and half: months, mean net return, SPY, net minus SPY, alpha (t), beta, the equal-weight universe, months beating SPY, worst month, turnover, delisted-in-month count, average eligible names. Pooled: alpha (t), alpha without the 3 best months, the 3 best months with their names, MDE. Year by year net minus SPY.
no_retuning: The five rules, 20 names, equal weight, monthly rebalance at month-end closes, 10 bp per side, the eligibility rule, and the halves are fixed. Another rule, book size, or weighting is a new prereg.
command: On the mini, after a result-skeptic Mode 1 READY on this prereg and its script: REPO=$PWD nice -n 19 .venv/bin/python tools/studies/monthly_book.py (inventory), then with --score. Reads daily.pkl only; no API calls; no config edit.
